modalLead: Emby and Plex join Jellyfin on the dashboard, each with a now playing tile. Shift+T opens the tag view of every bookmark, and Find tags works in the inbox too.

items.text: Now playing, for Jellyfin, Emby and Plex. A tile shows who is watching what right now and how far along. Emby and Plex also get a tile of what was added lately; Plex is read through Tautulli, whose API key only reads.
items.title: Now playing for Jellyfin, Emby and Plex

media.alt: A page with an Emby tile of what was added lately, and now playing tiles for Jellyfin and Plex showing who is watching what

items.text: Media tiles refresh on every beat, and no longer show Loading… between readings.
Every bookmark in one tag view. Shift+T with no bookmark selected opens it: all bookmarks from every page, a Without tags filter at the top and the tags in use under it.
items.title: Every bookmark in one tag view

media.alt: Shift+T with nothing selected opens the tag view of every bookmark; the Without tags filter then narrows the list

items.text: Find tags in the inbox. The ⋯ menu offers a tag for each link, and a With a tag suggestion filter keeps the list to the links that have one.
items.title: Find tags for your inbox

media.alt: The inbox after Find tags: dashed chips with the tag on offer on each link, and a count over the list

items.text: Self-hosted apps are recognised by name. A Sonarr at 192.168.1.20 or sonarr.home.lan now gets its tags, and a home address offers #self-hosted.
items.title: Self-hosted apps known by name

media.alt: The tags field of the bookmark form for sonarr.home.lan, with homelab and media-server suggested from the name alone

items.text: A much bigger catalogue. Thousands more sites and dozens of new subjects, among them tech, dev, science, sports and self-hosted apps, and sites that were filed under the wrong subject now sit where they belong.
What you turned down is easy to find. The Bookmarks view, the tag view and the inbox say how many suggestions you turned down, and let you offer any of them again.

Find tags shows which bookmarks it means. It leaves an offer on each row instead of adding tags straight away, and Add what it finds straight away is a setting that follows you to your other browsers.
The arrow keys walk the tag cloud in reading order, and every suggestion in a row can be seen.
The page filter stays at the top on a phone. It does not take focus, so the keyboard stays down until you tap it.
Keep settings on this device only now keeps them on this device: a theme set on the phone no longer turns up in your other browsers.
